en-GB.title: Recipe Saver App – Cookbook, Meal Plan & Shopping List
en-GB.description: Share a recipe from Safari, Instagram or TikTok and get a clean recipe card. Scale servings, cook step by step, plan your week and build a shopping list.
en-GB.h1: Recipe Saver App – save recipes, plan meals, shop
en-GB.lead: Share a recipe from any app or website and Recipe Saver turns it into a clean recipe card you can cook from. It also handles the meal plan and shopping list.

benefits.d: Share from Safari, Instagram, TikTok and more.
Big text, one step at a time, and the screen stays on.
Drag recipes onto days and add the week to the list (Pro).
Reads English, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish and Finnish.

faq.q: How do I save a recipe?
faq.a: Tap Share in Safari, Instagram, TikTok or any other app and choose Recipe Saver. You check the recipe before it is saved and can fix anything.

faq.q: Does it read recipe websites automatically?
faq.a: Yes, links to recipe websites are read automatically: title, ingredients, steps, time, servings and photo.

faq.q: Can I scale servings and convert units?
faq.a: Yes, you can scale servings up and down and convert cups and ounces to dl and grams.

faq.q: How many recipes can I save without Pro?
faq.a: Up to 15 recipes, with cooking mode and the shopping list. Pro adds unlimited recipes, screenshot reading, smart import, the meal plan and collections.
You can choose a yearly subscription or a one-time purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends.
